column1: # Partition table for ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1-N32R16V (32 MB flash)
# Layout (all offsets are from flash base 0x0000):
#   0xe000         otadata           8 KB    – OTA data (tracks active OTA slot)
#   0x10000        ota_0             3 MB    – App slot 0 (initial active slot)
#   0x310000       ota_1             3 MB    – App slot 1 (OTA update target)
# ota_0 / ota_1 at 3 MB each gives comfortable headroom for firmware growth
# while still leaving ~26 MB for the LittleFS partition.
